
prefix-set pl150-deny
end-set

prefix-set pl150-permit
  10.1.0.0/16,
  10.10.0.0/15 ge 16 le 16,
  10.10.1.0/24,
  10.12.0.0/16
end-set

prefix-set pl151-deny
end-set

prefix-set pl151-permit
  10.2.0.0/16
end-set

prefix-set pl152-permit
  0.0.0.0/0 le 32
end-set

prefix-set pl152-deny
  0.0.0.0/8 le 32,
  10.0.0.0/8 le 32,
  127.0.0.0/8 le 32
end-set

exit
!
route-policy AS2-IN-1
if destination in pl150-permit and not destination in pl150-deny then
 set local-preference 990
 set med 5
 set community (1:100) additive
 done
endif
if destination in pl151-permit and not destination in pl151-deny then
 done
endif
if destination in pl152-permit and not destination in pl152-deny then
 done
endif
end-policy
!
router bgp 1
!
 neighbor 10.0.0.2
 remote-as 2
  address-family ipv4 unicast
   route-policy AS2-IN-1 in
exit

prefix-set pl153-deny
end-set

prefix-set pl153-permit
  10.10.0.0/16,
  10.10.1.0/24,
  10.13.0.0/16,
  10.21.0.0/16 ge 24 le 24,
  10.22.0.0/16
end-set

prefix-set pl154-deny
end-set

prefix-set pl154-permit
  10.3.0.0/16
end-set

exit
!
route-policy AS3-IN-2
if destination in pl153-permit and not destination in pl153-deny then
 set local-preference 980
 done
endif
if destination in pl154-permit and not destination in pl154-deny then
 done
endif
if destination in pl152-permit and not destination in pl152-deny then
 done
endif
end-policy
!
router bgp 1
!
 neighbor 10.0.0.3
 remote-as 3
  address-family ipv4 unicast
   route-policy AS3-IN-2 in
exit

exit
as-path-set as-set50-permit
 ios-regex '^_4(_(1|10|11|12|14))*$'
end-set

as-path-set as-set50-deny
end-set

community-set commset50-permit
4:1
end-set

community-set commset50-deny
end-set

exit
!
route-policy AS4-IN-3
if destination in pl152-permit and not destination in pl152-deny then
 done
endif
if as-path in as-set50-permit and not as-path in as-set50-deny then
 if community matches-any commset50-permit and not community matches-any commset50-deny then
  done
 endif
endif
end-policy
!
router bgp 1
!
 neighbor 10.0.0.4
 remote-as 4
  address-family ipv4 unicast
   route-policy AS4-IN-3 in
exit

prefix-set pl155-deny
end-set

prefix-set pl155-permit
  10.5.0.0/16
end-set

community-set commset51-deny
  5:666
end-set

community-set commset51-permit
  *
end-set

exit
!
route-policy AS5-IN-4
if destination in pl152-permit and not destination in pl152-deny then
 done
endif
if destination in pl155-permit and not destination in pl155-deny then
  prepend as-path 1 2
 done
endif
if community matches-any commset51-permit and not community matches-any commset51-deny then
  prepend as-path 1 2
 done
endif
end-policy
!
router bgp 1
!
 neighbor 10.0.0.5
 remote-as 5
  address-family ipv4 unicast
   route-policy AS5-IN-4 in
exit
